limitations: Positive statement invokes Bu et al., Theorem 5.1, rather than a new proof.
The witness disproves EFX-plus-integral-PO lotteries; not EFX alone or EF1-plus-PO.
Enumerative certificate is complete only for the specified finite valuation matrix.
Integral Pareto optimality is not fractional Pareto optimality.
Novelty assessment cannot exclude unpublished or inaccessible prior examples.
scientific_integrity.precise_claim: The universal guarantee for ex-ante envy-free lotteries supported on EFX and integral Pareto-optimal complete allocations holds for common two-valued additive singleton utilities but can fail with a globally three-valued, strictly positive three-agent four-good instance.
scientific_integrity.scope: Complete allocations of indivisible goods; nonnegative additive valuations for the published positive theorem; strictly positive additive values for the displayed negative witness.

title: Three singleton-value levels are necessary and sufficient for failure of ex-ante EF with ex-post EFX and Pareto optimality
